headline: US Strikes IRGC Missile Launchers as Iran Vows Heavy Retaliation
subheadline: Iran's Khatam Al-Anbiya Headquarters and Armed Forces General Staff warned of overwhelming force against any further US or Israeli aggression.
lede: The US military struck IRGC missile launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing at least three and prompting Iranian threats of a heavy retaliatory response. Iran's Khatam Al-Anbiya Headquarters and Armed Forces General Staff vowed overwhelming force against any aggression, while the US continued removing ships from the Strait and Israel conducted strikes on Hamas targets in Gaza. The situation across the Persian Gulf, Lebanon, and Gaza remains highly escalated.

sections.title: Russia Advances in Summer Campaign
sections.body: Russian forces claimed to have liberated 91 populated points during the summer 2026 campaign, marking a major territorial advance. A strike on a Nova Poshta terminal in Odessa destroyed a distribution center used for military supplies, indicating a deliberate attack on logistical infrastructure. Attack drone operators from the Southern Group disrupted Ukrainian logistics in Druzhkovka and Malotaranovka, affecting supply routes and equipment caches. Russian air defenses shot down over 90 'Flamingo' cruise missiles during the summer.

sections.title: Escalation Intensifies in Persian Gulf
sections.body: The US attacked two IRGC missile launchers on Larak Island that were ready to launch missiles with sea mines toward the Strait of Hormuz. The death toll from the US attack rose to three after a wounded man died from his wounds. Iran's Khatam Al-Anbiya Central Headquarters and Armed Forces General Staff threatened a far heavier response to any attack, warning the US must leave the region. The IRGC stated the enemy's Arab operation will not go unanswered and vowed fierce retaliatory attacks soon.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Both conflicts show clear escalation patterns with explicit threats of retaliation from Iran and demonstrated territorial gains by Russian forces. The US and Iran are engaged in a high-stakes cycle of strikes and threats across the Persian Gulf, while Russia continues its summer offensive with significant territorial claims. Active hostilities across multiple domains suggest both regions remain highly volatile.
